confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates. Tottori-specific figures come from crowdsourced or modelled sites (citycost, almurakib, expatistan) and conflict with Japan-wide 2026 guides, so beer and meal figures are roughly plus or minus 20-30 percent. Cocktail and wine use the local beer relationship plus izakaya venue examples, since no aggregated survey was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or listings were checked. The FX observation was not read directly from rba.gov.au: the 0.6720 value for 2026-11-18 came from a secondary report of the RBA 4pm fix, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is other mid-sized, lower-cost Japanese regional cities rather than a named comparable. Food anchors use Tottori crowdsourced figures and Japan-wide 2026 price guides, with yen converted at roughly 150 JPY per USD. Accommodation uses general knowledge of regional Japanese business hotels, guesthouses and hostels for a July 2026 window.
